card.name: Digits inside numbers before units
card.fires_on: A digit or slash partway through a number, time, or ordinal, just before a unit or suffix such as pm, AM, MB, th or a unit ratio. The next piece is usually a short letter or unit, not a space.

modes.label: Times of day
modes.description: Last digit of a clock time right before am or pm.

modes.label: Sizes and ordinals
modes.description: A digit in a decimal file size or an ordinal number before MB or th.

modes.label: Unit ratios
modes.description: The slash inside a dose-per-activity unit such as μGy/MBq.
modes.example: μGy/ MBq rad/mCi μGy<</>> MBq rad/mCi μG

card.writes: It promotes capital letters without a leading space, such as P, M, C and D, and suppresses capitals with a space, which suggests a unit or abbreviation follows directly.
card.plain: It marks a spot inside a number where a unit or short abbreviation like pm, MB or th comes next.
